name: The Lécuyer Cult
source:
The story of Family at Home continues in The Lécuyer Cult, you will take the role of Kilian, a 22-year-old boy, in search of his two missing friends, you are invited to the cult, a place where men and women are fascinated by lust, it is dedicated to orgies in honor of Jessabelle Lécuyer, the late creator of the cult.

This universe, which began in Family at Home, will be fully explored in this game.

You will be invited to spend a month at the mansion, where you will meet many girls, and have fun with them, but you will also witness totally strange things. Are your eyes ready to see what happens to the Lécuyers?

[From Itch.io]
translation:
《居家一家人》的故事在续作《莱屈耶教团》中得以延续：你将扮演22岁的青年基利安，在追查两名失踪好友下落的过程中受邀踏入一座邪教庄园——这里的男男女女皆沉迷于色欲狂欢，终日举办淫乱派对，以此祭奠教团已故创始人杰莎贝尔·莱屈耶。

始于《居家一家人》的这一世界观，将在本作中得到全面深入的展现。

你将受邀在庄园内小住一个月，结识众多女孩并与她们尽情寻欢作乐，同时也会亲眼目睹种种匪夷所思的怪事。你的双眼准备好见证莱屈耶家族身上发生的秘密了吗？

[摘自itch.io]
